items.name: conventions
items.title: Frontend conventions
items.description: DESIGN.md and the AGENTS.md stub that points at it. Install this first in any new project.

items.name: agent-skill
items.title: Conventions skill (project-scope)
items.description: Checks the conventions skill into the repo so it loads in ephemeral cloud sandboxes (Claude Code on web and mobile) with no install step.

items.name: api-client
items.title: API client
items.description: Typed fetch wrapper with RFC 9457 problem+json error parsing. The only file that knows the base URL.

items.name: query-setup
items.title: TanStack Query defaults
items.description: Shared QueryClient configuration so retry, staleness and refetch behaviour is identical everywhere.

items.name: theme
items.title: Theme tokens
items.description: Semantic CSS variables for light and dark. Import after the Tailwind entry point.
